title: Work-symbol relabelling commutes with a run
statement: Let $M$ be a multi-tape Turing machine with symbol set $S$, and let $e:S\\simeq S$ be a bijection. For any input word $x$, configuration $c$ on $x$, and number of steps $t\\in\\mathbb{N}$, the configuration reached in $t$ steps by the machine whose work-tape symbols are relabelled by $e$, starting from $c$ with its work-tape symbols relabelled by $e$, is the configuration reached by $M$ from $c$ in $t$ steps with its work-tape symbols relabelled by $e$.
hypotheses_covered: A multi-tape Turing machine over symbol set $S$
An input word and a configuration on that input
